label: PRIOR_IN_SUBSTANCE_3: PriorInSubstance y x: y is prior to x in substance, that is in perfection
term: prior in substance (prius substantia et perfectione)
definition: `PriorInSubstance y x`: y is prior to x in substance, that is in perfection (prius substantia et perfectione, In Metaph. IX, lect. 9 n. 1, said of distinct beings). A Lean primitive, distinct from simple priority (DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY, characterized by the reduction of potency to act) and from priority in time (DEF-PRIORITY-IN-TIME). No source read for #352 identifies it with simple priority; ActPriorFromIncorruptibleFacts passes to simple priority only through the explicit unattributed hypothesis PriorInSubstanceIsSimpleReading. The linked declaration is the premise IncorruptiblePriorInSubstanceReading that constrains this primitive, not a definition of it.
